content:
IDC today released a report stating that Huawei and Apple are the only manufacturers to have recorded smartphone shipment growth in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results mark the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline.

The report points out that Apple was the strongest performer in year-on-year shipment growth among major Chinese smartphone manufacturers in the second quarter of 2026, with an increase of 24.4%.

This growth propelled Apple's ranking from fifth to second place, with market share climbing from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei continues to lead the market, with smartphone shipments accounting for 22.6% of the market during the quarter.

However, all other major smartphone manufacturers recorded year-on-year declines, with shipment drops reaching as high as 60.8%, due to factors including rising memory and component costs, the reduction of government subsidies, and weakening consumer demand — particularly evident during the "618" shopping festival.

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with shipments of approximately 66 million units during the quarter.
